jobs.prompt: Run checklist `publish-digest`. Call all collect-* skills in parallel. For each new item call score-relevance. Drop items < 6. For survivors call enrich-fetch (if body missing) then summarize-tldr. Skills pick their own LLM tier (low/mid/high); the actual model resolves from LLM_PROVIDER + MODEL_LOW/MID/HIGH env. Then post-telegram for each. Respect MAX_POSTS_PER_HOUR. Return one-line stats.
Build the daily digest: top 10 items by score from the last 24h. Use post-telegram with kind=digest.
Compute rising topics/authors/repos week-over-week and post a `Rising` digest to the channel.
